why.en: Teredo tunnels IPv6 over IPv4 and can add a slower path that some games pick.
why.tr: Teredo IPv6 trafigini IPv4 uzerinden tuneller ve bazi oyunlarin sectigi daha yavas bir yol ekleyebilir.

apply: netsh interface teredo set state type=disabled
revert: netsh interface teredo set state type=default
